# Claude Code CLI：快捷键与斜杠命令完整参考（2025-2026）

以下是截至 2026 年最新的 Claude Code 键盘快捷键和斜杠命令的完整参考。

---

## ⌨️ 键盘快捷键

### 核心快捷键

| 快捷键 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+C` | 取消当前生成/输入 |
| `Ctrl+D` | 退出 Claude Code |
| `Ctrl+L` | 清空终端屏幕 |
| `Ctrl+R` | 反向搜索命令历史 |
| `Esc` | 中断当前动作 |
| `Esc + Esc` | 回退到上一个检查点（撤销） |
| `Shift+Tab` / `Alt+M` | 循环切换权限模式（默认 → 自动接受 → 计划模式） |
| `Ctrl+O` | 切换详细输出/转录模式 |
| `Ctrl+T` | 切换任务列表 |
| `Ctrl+F` | 终止所有后台代理（按两次） |
| `Ctrl+G` / `Ctrl+X Ctrl+E` | 在外部编辑器（vim 等）中打开输入 |
| `Ctrl+B` | 将任务置入后台运行 |

### 输入与编辑

| 快捷键 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| `\ + Enter` | 换行（多行输入）——跨平台通用 |
| `Shift+Enter` / `Option+Enter` | 换行（不发送） |
| `Ctrl+J` | 插入换行 |
| `Ctrl+K` | 删除至行尾 |
| `Ctrl+U` | 删除整行 |
| `Ctrl+Y` | 粘贴已删除的文本 |
| `Alt+B` / `Alt+F` | 光标前后移动一个词 |
| `Cmd+V`（Mac）/ `Ctrl+V`（Win/Linux） | 从剪贴板粘贴图片 |
| `Ctrl+S` | 暂存当前提示（稍后自动恢复） |
| `Ctrl+_` / `Ctrl+Shift+-` | 撤销上一步输入操作 |
| `↑` / `↓` | 在命令历史中导航 |

### 模型与模式切换

| 快捷键 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| `Option+P`（Mac）/ `Alt+P`（Win/Linux） | 切换模型（Sonnet / Opus / Haiku） |
| `Option+T`（Mac）/ `Alt+T`（Win/Linux） | 切换扩展思考模式 |
| `Shift+Tab` / `Alt+M` | 循环切换权限模式 |
| `Meta+O` | 切换快速模式 |
| `?` | 查看所有可用快捷键 |

### 快速前缀

| 前缀 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| `/` | 打开斜杠命令菜单 |
| `!` | 直接执行 bash 命令 |
| `@` | 自动补全文件路径提及 |

---

## ⚡ 斜杠命令完整列表

### 会话与上下文管理

| 命令 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| `/clear` | 清除对话历史，释放上下文窗口 |
| `/compact [focus]` | 压缩对话历史，保留摘要；可指定保留重点 |
| `/cost` | 显示当前会话的 Token 用量与 API 费用 |
| `/context` | 可视化当前上下文使用情况（彩色网格） |
| `/resume` | 选择并恢复之前的会话 |
| `/rename [name]` | 命名当前会话，便于后续恢复 |
| `/rewind` | 将代码和对话回退至之前的检查点 |
| `/diff` | 查看所有更改的交互式差异 |
| `/copy [N]` | 复制最近一次回复（可指定倒数第 N 条） |
| `/export [file]` | 将会话导出为文本文件 |
| `/branch [name]` | 在当前节点创建对话分支（原 `/fork`） |
| `/recap` | 生成当前工作阶段的单行摘要 |
| `/btw <question>` | 侧边问题，不写入对话历史 |

|---|---|

| `/effort [level]` | 设置推理力度（low / medium / high / xhigh / max / auto） |
| `/fast [on\|off]` | 切换快速模式 |
| `/config` | 打开设置界面（别名：`/settings`） |
| `/permissions` | 查看和管理工具权限 |
| `/theme` | 更改色彩主题 |
| `/color [color]` | 设置提示栏颜色 |
| `/tui [default\|fullscreen]` | 切换终端 UI 渲染器 |
| `/focus` | 切换焦点视图 |
| `/scroll-speed` | 调整鼠标滚轮滚动速度 |
| `/keybindings` | 打开或创建快捷键配置文件 |
| `/terminal-setup` | 配置终端键位绑定 |
| `/statusline` | 配置状态栏显示内容 |

|---|---|
| `/init` | 初始化项目——创建 CLAUDE.md 并写入代码库文档 |

| `/add-dir <path>` | 添加另一个目录到工作上下文 |
| `/plan [description]` | 进入计划模式——只读探索，先规划再动手 |
| `/execute` | 退出计划模式，执行更改 |

| `/tasks` | 列出并管理后台任务（别名：`/bashes`） |
| `/agents` | 管理 Agent 配置 |

| `/debug [description]` | 排查当前会话中的问题 |
| `/autofix-pr [prompt]` | 生成网页会话监控 PR，在 CI 失败或 review 评论时自动推送修复 |

### 代码审查与安全

| 命令 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| `/review [PR]` | 审查 Pull Request |
| `/ultrareview` | 深度云端 PR 审查 |
| `/security-review` | 对当前分支待处理变更进行安全审查 |
| `/pr-comments [PR]` | 获取并处理 GitHub PR 审查评论 |
| `/simplify` | 审查已更改代码的质量问题并提供改进建议 |

### MCP、插件与集成

| 命令 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| `/mcp` | 管理 MCP 服务器连接 |
| `/plugin install\|enable\|disable\|list\|marketplace` | 管理插件 |
| `/reload-plugins` | 热重载所有活跃插件 |
| `/skills` | 列出可用技能 |
| `/hooks` | 查看和管理配置的钩子 |
| `/ide` | 管理 IDE 集成并显示状态 |
| `/chrome` | 配置 Chrome 浏览器集成 |
| `/install-github-app` | 为仓库设置 Claude GitHub Actions |
| `/install-slack-app` | 安装 Claude Slack 应用 |
| `/voice [hold\|tap\|off]` | 切换语音听写模式（按住 Space） |
| `/desktop` | 将当前会话交给桌面端应用 |
| `/teleport` | 将网页/iOS 会话拉入终端（别名：`/tp`） |
| `/remote-control` | 使得 claude.ai 可远程控制此会话（别名：`/rc`） |

### 系统、诊断与账户

# Claude Code: Status Line, Plan Mode, Memory System, IDE Integration & Settings (2025)

Here's a comprehensive overview of these five key areas of Claude Code based on the latest documentation and community resources:

---

## 1. Status Line (`/statusline`)

Claude Code provides a **status line** at the bottom of the terminal interface that shows real-time session information:

- **Current permission mode** indicator (e.g., `⏸ plan mode on`, `Normal`, `Auto-Accept`)
- **Active context file** reference (e.g., `⧉ In claude-context.md`)
- **Keyboard shortcut hints** (e.g., `shift+tab to cycle`)

### `/statusline` Command
You can customize the status line via the `/statusline` slash command (sets up the status bar UI). In `settings.json`, you can configure a **custom status line**:

```json
{
  "statusLine": {
    "type": "command",
    "command": "..."
  }
}
```

### `/status` Dashboard
The related `/status` command opens a **three-tab interactive dashboard**:

| Tab | Contents |
|-----|----------|
| **Status** | Version, session ID, working directory, account info, model details, **IDE integration status**, configuration sources |
| **Config** | Auto-compact, show tips, rewind/checkpoints, verbose output, theme (dark/light), notifications, output style, editor mode, model, diff tool, auto-install IDE extension |
| **Usage** | Session usage %, weekly usage % (all models), weekly Opus usage %, with reset times and timezone |

> **Limitation:** `/status` only works in interactive sessions (not via `claude -p`), is a static snapshot (no live refresh), and cannot be exported.

---

## 2. Plan Mode

**Plan Mode** is a two-phase approach where Claude researches and creates a detailed plan **before** making any changes.

### How It Works
- **Planning Phase:** Claude uses **read-only tools only** (Read, LS, Grep/Glob, WebSearch/WebFetch, research sub-agents)
- **All write tools are blocked** — no file edits, no bash commands that modify state, no config changes, no commits
- After presenting the plan, Claude calls an `exit_plan_mode` tool to prompt user confirmation
- Once approved, Claude executes the plan step-by-step

### Activation Methods

| Method | Command/Key |
|--------|-------------|
| **Keyboard shortcut** | `Shift+Tab` twice (cycles: Normal → Auto-Accept → Plan) |
| **CLI flag** | `claude --permission-mode plan` |
| **Headless pipe** | `claude --permission-mode plan -p "Analyze the auth system"` |
| **Slash command** | `/plan Implement user authentication system` |
| **Default in settings** | `{ "permissions": { "defaultMode": "plan" } }` |
| **Model alias** | `claude --model opusplan` (uses Opus for planning, Sonnet for execution) |

### When to Use
| ✅ Use Plan Mode | ❌ Skip Plan Mode |
|---|---|
| Complex multi-file refactoring | Simple bug fixes |
| New feature implementations | Formatting changes |
| Architectural changes | Single-file edits |
| Database migrations | Quick queries |
| Major API redesigns | Well-understood repetitive tasks |

### v2.1.136 Update
> Plan mode now **unconditionally blocks all file writes**, even when a matching `Edit(...)` rule exists in `permissions.allow`. If you need edits, exit plan mode first.

### Ultraplan (Research Preview, v2.1.91+)
`/ultraplan` offloads planning to a **cloud session** (claude.ai/code) while your terminal stays free. Claude drafts the plan remotely, you review in the browser with inline comments and reactions, then either execute in the cloud or "teleport" back to your terminal. Requires a GitHub repo and a Claude Code on the web account.

---

## 3. Memory System

Claude Code uses a **multi-tier hierarchical memory system** based on `CLAUDE.md` files. Files are auto-loaded at session start, with higher-precedence levels overriding lower ones.

### Memory Hierarchy (Highest to Lowest Priority)

| Priority | Level | Location | Scope |
|----------|-------|----------|-------|
| 1 (Highest) | **Managed Policy** | `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/CLAUDE.md` (macOS), `/etc/claude-code/CLAUDE.md` (Linux), `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\CLAUDE.md` (Windows) | Organization-wide |
| 1.5 | **Managed Drop-ins** | `managed-settings.d/*.md` (v2.1.83+) | Modular policy files |
| 2 | **Project Memory** | `./CLAUDE.md` or `./.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Team-shared (version controlled) |
| 3 | **Project Rules** | `./.claude/rules/*.md` | Modular, topic-specific |
| 4 | **User Memory** | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Personal (all projects) |
| 5 | **User Rules** | `~/.claude/rules/*.md` | Personal modular rules |
| 6 | **Local Project** | `./CLAUDE.local.md` | Personal, git-ignored |
| 7 (Lowest) | **Auto Memory** | `~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/` | Claude's automatic learnings |

### Key Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `/init` | Generate starter `CLAUDE.md` by analyzing your project |
| `/memory` | Open memory files in your system editor for editing |
| `@path/to/file` | Import external docs into `CLAUDE.md` |

### Rules Directory Structure
```
your-project/
├── .claude/
│   ├── CLAUDE.md
│   └── rules/
│       ├── code-style.md
│       ├── testing.md
│       └── security.md
```
Rules are discovered **recursively** and support subdirectories (e.g., `rules/api/conventions.md`).

### Auto Memory
- **Location:** `~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/`
- **Entrypoint:** `MEMORY.md` (first 200 lines / 25KB loaded at session start)
- **Written by Claude during sessions** — records patterns, learnings, and project-specific knowledge automatically

---

## 4. IDE Integration

Claude Code integrates with major IDEs through extensions and the `/ide` slash command.

### Supported IDEs
- **VS Code** — Official Claude Code extension
- **Cursor** — Official Claude Code extension
- **JetBrains** — Official Claude Code extension
- **iTerm2 / Terminal** — Via `/terminal-setup` for Shift+Enter keybinding

### Key Commands & Settings

| Command/Setting | Purpose |
|-----------------|---------|
| `/ide` | Manage IDE integration, display connection status |
| Auto-install IDE extension | Toggle in Config — automatically installs extensions |
| `/terminal-setup` | Install Shift+Enter keybindings for iTerm2 and VS Code terminal |

### Connection Status
The `/status` dashboard's **Status tab** shows:
- Whether your IDE extension is **properly connected**
- Version mismatches between CLI and extension
- Helps debug IDE integration issues

### IDE Workflow
The extension lets you see your code **side-by-side** while Claude works — same tool as the CLI but with a visual interface for diff review, multiple parallel sessions, and in-editor context.

---

## 5. Settings & Configuration

Settings follow a **five-level hierarchy** (higher takes precedence):

| Priority | Location | Scope |
|----------|----------|-------|
| 1 (Highest) | **Managed policy** (system-level) | Organization enforcement |
| 2 | `managed-settings.d/` (v2.1.83+) | Modular policy drop-ins |
| 3 | `~/.claude/settings.json` | User preferences |
| 4 | `.claude/settings.json` | Project-level (committed) |
| 5 (Lowest) | `.claude/settings.local.json` | Local overrides (git-ignored) |

> **v2.1.119 update:** `/config` changes now persist to `~/.claude/settings.json` — they're no longer session-only.

### Key Settings Options

```json
{
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
  "permissions": {
    "defaultMode": "plan",
    "allow": [...],
    "deny": [...],
    "ask": [...]
  },
  "statusLine": { "type": "command", "command": "..." },
  "outputStyle": "Explanatory",
  "alwaysThinkingEnabled": true,
  "sandbox": { "enabled": true },
  "hooks": { "PreToolUse": {...} },
  "disableAllHooks": true,
  "env": { "FOO": "bar" },
  "attribution": { "commit": "...", "pr": "..." },
  "forceLoginMethod": "claudeai"
}
```

### Platform-Specific Configuration (v2.1.51+)
- **macOS:** Property list (`.plist`) files

# Claude Code: Skills & Slash Commands Tutorial (2025)

Here's a comprehensive guide to using skills and slash commands in Claude Code, based on the latest 2025 documentation and community resources.

---

## Key Concept: Skills vs Slash Commands

**As of late 2025, Claude Code has unified Slash Commands under the Skill system.** The `SlashCommand` tool has been removed, and slash commands (e.g., `/commit`, `/review-pr`) are now invoked through the `Skill` tool. When you type `/command`, Claude treats it as a skill invocation.

| Aspect | Skill | Slash Command |
|---|---|---|
| **Invocation** | Automatic (context-driven) or via `/name` | Explicit (`/cmd`) |
| **Complexity** | High (multi-file, scripts, templates) | Low (single `.md` file) |
| **File Structure** | Directory + `SKILL.md` | Single `.md` file |
| **Best For** | Multi-step workflows, team standardization | Quick prompts, explicit control |

---

## Custom Slash Commands (Quick Start)

### 1. Create a Command File

**Project-scoped** (shared with team via git):
```bash
mkdir -p .claude/commands
```

**Personal** (available across all projects):
```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/commands
```

Create a file like `.claude/commands/review.md`:
```markdown
---
description: Review code for security vulnerabilities
argument-hint: [file-path]
allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob
---

Review @$ARGUMENTS for security vulnerabilities including:
- SQL injection
- XSS attacks
- Authentication issues
- Insecure data handling

Provide specific line numbers and severity ratings.
```

Invoke with `/review src/api/users.ts`.

### 2. Arguments & Placeholders

- **`$ARGUMENTS`** — Captures all arguments as one string
  ```markdown
  # /fix-issue 123 high-priority → $ARGUMENTS = "123 high-priority"
  Fix issue #$ARGUMENTS following our coding standards.
  ```

- **`$1, $2, $3`** — Individual positional arguments
  ```markdown
  # /review-pr 456 high alice → $1="456", $2="high", $3="alice"
  Review PR #$1 with priority $2 and assign to $3.
  ```

### 3. YAML Frontmatter Fields

| Field | Purpose | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | Shown in `/help` (required for tool access) | `"Review code for security issues"` |
| `argument-hint` | Argument syntax for autocomplete | `"[pr-number] [priority]"` |
| `allowed-tools` | Restrict which tools the command can use | `Bash(git add:*), Bash(git status:*)` |
| `model` | Override default model | `haiku` (fast), `sonnet` (standard), `opus` (complex) |
| `disable-model-invocation` | Prevent auto-invocation by Claude | `true` |

### 4. Bash Execution (`!`) & File References (`@`)

**Dynamic context with bash:**
```markdown
---
allowed-tools: Bash(git diff:*), Bash(git log:*)
description: Review recent commits
---
## Context
- Current status: !`git status`
- Recent commits: !`git log --oneline -5`

## Your Task
Provide a code quality review based on the changes above.
```

**File references:**
```markdown
Review the implementation in @src/utils/helpers.js
Compare @src/old-version.js with @src/new-version.js
```

---

## Custom Skills (Complete Guide)

### 1. Skill Structure

```
.claude/skills/pdf-processing/
├── SKILL.md              # Required: YAML frontmatter + instructions
├── FORMS.md              # Optional: supplemental docs
├── REFERENCE.md          # Optional: API references
├── scripts/
│   ├── fill_form.py
│   └── validate.py
└── templates/
    └── form_template.json
```

### 2. SKILL.md Format

```markdown
---
name: pdf-processor                          # Required: lowercase, hyphens, max 64 chars
description: Extract text and tables from PDF files, fill forms, merge documents.
             Use when working with PDF files, forms, or document extraction.
             Requires pdfplumber and pypdf packages.    # Required: max 1024 chars
allowed-tools: Read, Write, Bash, Grep       # Optional
---

# PDF Processing Skill

## Instructions
1. Use `pdfplumber` for text extraction
2. Use `pypdf` for form filling
3. Always validate input files exist before processing

## Examples
### Extract Text
python3 scripts/extract_text.py input.pdf

### Fill Form
python3 scripts/fill_form.py template.pdf --field name=John
```

### 3. Description Best Practices (Critical!)

The `description` field determines whether Claude **automatically discovers** your skill. Follow this formula:

```
description = [What it does] + [When to use it] + [Trigger keywords] + [Dependencies]
```

**❌ Bad:**
```yaml
description: Helps with documents
```

**✅ Good:**
```yaml
description: Extract text and tables from PDF files, fill forms, merge documents.
             Use when working with PDF files, forms, or document extraction.
             Requires pdfplumber and pypdf packages.
```

### 4. Skill Scopes

| Scope | Location | Shared Via |
|---|---|---|
| **Personal** | `~/.claude/skills/` | Not shareable |
| **Project** | `.claude/skills/` | Git (team) |
| **Plugin** | Plugin directory | Plugin distribution |

### 5. allowed-tools Options

Common tool restrictions for security:
```yaml
# Read-only analysis skill
allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob

# Git operations only
allowed-tools: Read, Bash(git add:*), Bash(git commit:*), Bash(git status:*)

# Full write access
allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep
```

---

## Quick Command Patterns

### Simple Review Command
```markdown
---
description: Review code for performance issues
argument-hint: [file-path]
---

Review @$ARGUMENTS for:
1. Algorithmic efficiency
2. Memory usage
3. Unnecessary allocations
4. Caching opportunities

Provide specific line numbers and suggested fixes.
```

### Git Commit Command
```markdown
---
description: Create a git commit from staged changes
allowed-tools: Bash(git add:*), Bash(git status:*), Bash(git commit:*), Bash(git log:*)
---

## Context
- Status: !`git status`
- Diff: !`git diff --cached`
- Recent commits: !`git log --oneline -5`

## Your Task
Create a single commit following the repo's commit style.
```

---

## Built-in Commands (Reference)

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/help` | List all commands |
| `/config` | Open Settings |
| `/status` | Show version/model/account |
| `/cost` | Token usage stats |
| `/model` | Switch AI model |
| `/memory` | Edit CLAUDE.md |
| `/clear` | Clear conversation history |
| `/agents` | Manage custom AI subagents |
| `/mcp` | Manage MCP server connections |

---

## Community Toolkits

For advanced usage, the **[Claude Code Skill Factory](https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-code-skill-factory)** provides:
- `/build skill` — Interactive skill builder
- `/build agent` — Interactive agent builder
- `/build hook` — Interactive hook builder
- 10 preset slash commands for common workflows
- 69 professional prompt presets across 15 domains

# Claude Code 多智能体功能全景：2025-2026

以下是关于 Claude Code 多智能体（multi-agent）功能——包括子代理（subagents）、任务团队（agent teams）和动态工作流——的全面综述。

---

## 一、三层架构总览

Claude Code 的多智能体能力分为三个层级：

| 层级 | 名称 | 成熟度 | 核心通信模式 |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| **第一层** | 主会话（Main Session） | 稳定 | 用户直接交互 |
| **第二层** | Sub-agents（子代理） | **稳定**（2025年底进入稳定版） | 星形拓扑——子代理只与主会话通信，彼此隔离 |
| **第三层** | Agent Teams（代理团队） | **实验性**（2026年2月推出） | 网状拓扑——Teammate 之间通过 Mailbox 直接通信 |

**关键设计原则**：Sub-agent 不能创建新的子代理（防止递归失控），Agent Teams 的 Teammate 本质上是特殊的 Sub-agent，受同样约束。

---

## 二、Sub-agents（子代理）——当前最成熟

### 内置子代理
Claude Code 开箱自带三个官方内置 Sub-agent：

| 子代理 | 功能 | 模型 | 权限 |
|--------|------|------|------|
| **Explore** | 只读代码探索、文件搜索 | Haiku | 仅读 |
| **Plan** | Plan Mode 下的代码库研究 | - | 只读，不能创建子代理 |
| **General-purpose** | 通用型，继承主会话所有工具 | - | 完整 |

### 自定义子代理配置
在 `.claude/agents/` 目录下创建 YAML 文件定义：

```yaml
# .claude/agents/code-reviewer.yml
name: code-reviewer
description: 专注于代码质量审查
system_prompt: |
  你是经验丰富的 code reviewer，聚焦安全漏洞、性能、规范、测试覆盖
tools:
  - read_file
  - search_files
  - bash
model: claude-haiku-4-5  # 轻量任务用轻量模型降低成本
```

**调用方式**：自然语言、@-mention（如 `@code-reviewer`）、CLAUDE.md 默认激活。

---

## 三、Agent Teams（代理团队）——2026年核心新功能

### 发布时间线

| 时间 | 事件 |
|------|------|
| **2026年2月5日** | Agent Teams 随 Claude Opus 4.6 发布，进入 Research Preview |
| **2026年2月** | 全行业多智能体浪潮——Codex CLI、Windsurf Wave 13、Grok Build、Cline CLI 2.0 同期发布 |
| **2026年5月28日** | **Dynamic Workflows** 发布——允许单会话运行数百个并行 sub-agent |

### 架构四大组件

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│        Team Lead（主会话）            │
│  · 分解任务 · 创建 teammates          │
│  · 综合所有结果                      │
└──────────┬──────────────────────────┘
           │
   ┌───────┴────────┐
   │                │
┌──▼──────────┐  ┌──▼──────────┐
│ Teammate 1  │◄─┼────────────►│ Teammate 2  │
│ 独立1M上下文 │  直接通信(邮箱)  │ 独立1M上下文 │
│ 自领任务    │                │ 自领任务    │
└─────────────┘                └─────────────┘
```

| 组件 | 作用 | 存储位置 |
|------|------|---------|
| **Team Lead** | 创建团队、协调工作、综合结果 | 主 Claude Code 会话 |
| **Teammates** | 独立实例，各自拥有完整上下文 | 独立进程（in-process 或 tmux 分屏） |
| **Task List** | 共享任务清单，带依赖追踪和自动解锁 | `~/.claude/tasks/{team-name}/` JSON |
| **Mailbox** | 代理间直接消息和广播 | 内存消息投递系统 |

### 如何开启

```json
// ~/.claude/settings.json
{
  "env": {
    "CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS": "1"
  },
  "team": {
    "maxSize": 5,
    "taskQueueSize": 30,
    "coordinationModel": "claude-opus-4-5",
    "workerModel": "claude-haiku-4-5"
  }
}
```

或环境变量：`export CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1`

### 前置条件
- **Claude Code v2.1.32+**
- **Opus 4.6 模型**（最低要求）
- **必须使用 CLI**（浏览器版不支持 Agent Teams）
- Git 仓库（用于协调）
- 分屏模式需要 tmux 或 iTerm2

---

## 四、Sub-agent vs Agent Teams 决策矩阵

| 维度 | Sub-agents | Agent Teams |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| **通信** | 仅向主会话汇报 | Teammate 之间直接通信 |
| **上下文** | 独立窗口，结果返回调用者 | 独立窗口，完全独立 |
| **协调** | 主代理管理一切 | 共享任务列表 + 自协调 |
| **Token成本** | **较低**（结果汇总返回） | **较高**（每个 teammate 独立实例） |
| **最佳场景** | 聚焦任务，只需结果 | 需讨论和协作的复杂任务 |
| **生产就绪** | ✅ 是 | ⚠️ 否（实验性，截至2026年4月） |

### 选择建议
- **优先使用 Sub-agent**：绝大多数企业自动化需求
- **考虑 Agent Teams**：需要多角色协商（多视角代码审查、竞争假设调试、跨层变更）

---

## 五、典型使用场景

### Agent Teams 三大验证场景

| 场景 | 案例来源 | 效果 |
|------|---------|------|
| **多维度代码审查** | Fountain（Anthropic报告） | 筛选速度提升 50% |
| **完整开发生命周期** | CRED（1500万用户，金融合规） | 执行速度 2x |
| **竞争假设调试** | Anthropic 研究团队 | 多假设并行排查，避免锚定偏差 |

### Dynamic Workflows（2026年5月发布）
- **代码库级 bug 搜索、安全审计**：数百个代理并行搜索和验证
- **大规模迁移**：框架替换、API 废弃、语言移植（如 Bun 从 Zig 到 Rust 的重写：75万行，11天，99.8% 测试通过率）
- **高代价任务的复核**：独立尝试 + 对抗代理，确保结果可靠

---

## 六、已知限制与踩坑指南

### Agent Teams 当前限制（截至2026年4月）

| 限制 | 详情 |
|------|------|
| **⚠️ /resume 不恢复 teammate** | 中断后 resume 只恢复 Team Lead，teammate 丢失 |
| **⚠️ 任务状态滞后** | Teammate 有时不标记任务完成，阻塞依赖任务 |
| **每会话一个团队** | 不能嵌套创建，teammate 不能创建子团队 |
| **Teammate 上限** | 最多 10 个（超出静默失败） |
| **不支持动态扩容** | 任务中途无法新增 teammate |
| **模型统一** | 所有 teammate 必须使用相同模型（Opus 4.6），不支持角色分级模型选择 |
| **上下文不继承** | Teammate 不继承 Lead 的对话历史，需在 spawn prompt 中提供所有上下文 |

### 避坑建议
1. **不要上生产**：实验性标签是认真的，先用内部开发环境积累经验
2. **画任务依赖图**：先找出可并行分支，再决定启动几个 agent
3. **从 3 个 agent 开始**：推荐起步规模 3-5 个，每人 5-6 个任务
4. **文件所有权隔离**：避免两个 agent 编辑同一文件
5. **任务描述要具体**：模糊的 prompt 等于浪费 token

---

## 七、Token 成本分析

成本是**乘法而非加法**：

| 场景 | Token消耗估算 |
|------|-------------|
| 单会话 | 基准（1x） |
| 主会话 + 5 个 Sub-agent | 约 **5x** |
| 5 人 Agent Team（含通信开销） | 约 **5-7x** |
| Dynamic Workflow（数百代理） | **显著更高**，Anthropic 建议从小范围任务开始 |

**省钱策略**：Team Lead 用 Opus 做协调推理，Teammate 用 Haiku 执行具体任务——但截至2026年3月，Agent Teams 不支持角色分级模型选择（社区已提出功能请求）。

---

## 八、企业级管控：Managed Agents

Claude Code v2 时代的企业基础设施，通过三层结构实现：

- **Managed Settings**：IT 管理员通过 `managed-settings.json`、MDM（Jamf/Kandji）或 Anthropic 管理后台统一下发策略，优先级最高不可覆盖
- **权限分层 + 工具隔离 + 上下文独立**
- 截至2026年4月已支持与 Jamf、Kandji 等 MDM 系统集成

---

## 九、行业展望

- **Gartner 预测**：到2026年底，40% 的企业应用将纳入任务特定代理
- **Anthropic 内部数据**（5000+ 组织）：工程师每日合并 PR 数提升 67%，27% 的任务在没有 AI 的情况下不会被完成
- **采用路径**：Pilot（1-2月）→ 扩展（3-4月）→ 生产（5-6月），成功率从 60-70% 提升至 85-90%

---

> 📌 **一句话总结**：Sub-agents 是现在就能用好的生产力工具；Agent Teams 是值得在开发环境探索的未来方向；Dynamic Workflows 正在重新定义「用 AI 做大项目」的上限。选择哪个取决于你的任务结构——有并行分支就用多智能体，线性依赖就用单会话。

## 3. How to Use Skills

Skills are automated workflows. Your project has 49+ custom skills (like `/brainstorm`, `/debug`, `/investigate`).

**Invoke a skill** by typing `/skill-name` followed by any arguments. Example: `/brainstorm a puzzle platformer about gravity`

**Two types:**
- **Project skills** live in `.claude/skills/` -- shared with your team via git
- **Personal skills** live in `~/.claude/skills/` -- available across all projects

**To see what's available:** type `/skills` or just press `/` to browse the menu.

**Plugins** add skill packs. Your project has plugins enabled (`superpowers`, `academic-writing-skills`, `research-workspace`). Manage them with `/plugin install|enable|disable|list`.

## 5. Plan Mode

Plan mode makes Claude research and design a plan **before** touching any files.

**Activate:** `Shift+Tab` twice (cycles: Normal -> Auto-Accept -> Plan), or type `/plan describe what you want`

**How it works:**
1. Claude uses read-only tools (search, read files, web search) to research
2. Presents you a complete plan with steps
3. You approve or request changes
4. After approval, Claude executes the plan

**Best for:** multi-file changes, new features, architectural work. Skip for simple one-line fixes or quick questions.

## 6. Memory System

Claude Code uses a hierarchy of `CLAUDE.md` files as persistent memory:

| Priority | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Highest | `./CLAUDE.md` (project root) | Team-shared, version-controlled |
| | `./.claude/rules/*.md` | Modular topic-specific rules |
| | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Your personal preferences (all projects) |
| Lowest | Auto-memory at `~/.claude/projects/*/memory/` | Learnings Claude saves automatically |

**Key commands:**
- `/init` -- auto-generate project memory from your codebase
- `/memory` -- open memory files for manual editing

Your project already uses this extensively (see `C:\Users\13751\CLAUDE.md` and `C:\Users\13751\.claude\docs\` for all the coordination rules, coding standards, etc.).

## 7. Multi-Agent Features

Your project has 49 configured subagents (game designers, programmers, QA testers, etc.) defined in `.claude/agents/`.

**Subagents** run inside your session. Claude spawns them automatically when a task matches their expertise (e.g., a combat design question triggers the `game-designer` agent).

**Agent Teams** (experimental, opt-in): multiple independent Claude sessions working in parallel on a shared task list. Requires setting `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1`. Best for large-scale work where tasks are truly independent.

**Dynamic Workflows** (new in May 2026): run hundreds of parallel subagents for codebase-wide searches, migrations, or audits.
